production_claim: none. prototype and reference implementation only. all results are obtained against a synthetic environment authored by this project and support no claim about real systems.
note_on_completion: No artifact is marked COMPLETE. DRAFTED means written and internally consistent. Gate 0 exits only on human review plus resolution of the three acceptance-blocking open questions.

gate_0_exit_criteria.criterion: Human review of all seven documents
OQ-05 resolved (CAS retention per sensitivity class)
ADR-0001 moved from PROPOSED to ACCEPTED

design_decisions.title: Runtime gateway is the sole enforcement boundary; model only proposes
Adjudicated action state with first-class UNKNOWN_OUTCOME; retry legality from a contract-tested capability matrix
Evidence label is a function of extraction method, enforced at write; LLM may emit only HYPOTHESIS
Causal claims only from paired fault-injection interventions with divergence-aware replay
Minimum viable infrastructure; deterministic substrate for ~90% of evaluation trials

dangerous_assumptions.assumption: Real enterprise tools expose postcondition probes and idempotency keys at a useful rate.
Tools declare their consistency model truthfully, or UNDECLARED is never overridden for convenience.
dangerous_assumptions.test: per-tool consistency contract test + replica-lag fault

dangerous_assumptions.assumption: No retry occurs beneath our gateway (HTTP client, SDK, service mesh).
Deterministic-stub reliability results are predictive of real-model behaviour.
dangerous_assumptions.test: 3% remote sample must agree with stub results within stated bounds

dangerous_assumptions.assumption: Trajectory divergence in CONTROLLED_REPLAY is rare enough for counterfactuals to be obtainable.
The control plane remains single-writer, making seq ordering authoritative.
~6 model calls and ~3000 tokens per execution.
Hypothesis rubric criteria are sufficiently independent that summing them is meaningful.
Identical repeated tool calls indicate a fault rather than legitimate work.
dangerous_assumptions.test: false-positive rate of D-LOOP-REPEAT on polling workloads

dangerous_assumptions.assumption: The provider budgets in PROJECT_CONTEXT.json are approximately current.
dangerous_assumptions.test: read live rate-limit headers at Gate 1; never hard-code

dangerous_assumptions.assumption: Human labelling capacity exists for judge calibration and disputed-grade adjudication.
The ten design_truths cited in PROJECT_CONTEXT.json as FACT are accurate.
invalidates: any mechanism justified solely by a citation
dangerous_assumptions.test: human verification of each source; see PROJECT_CHARTER 0.1

architectural_failure_modes.name: duplicate side effects despite the gateway
probe manufactures the bug it prevents (consistency window)
schema drift silently invalidates keys, detectors, baselines
provider or model drift invalidates baselines
silent provider fallback with changed guarantees
security policy bypass at the action boundary
sensitive data accumulates in telemetry and CAS
partial infrastructure failure yields plausible-but-wrong analysis

open_questions.question: What fraction of real enterprise write endpoints support an idempotency key or a postcondition probe?
open_questions.resolution_method: Survey public API docs for three real SaaS surfaces (ticketing, identity, HR). Classify every write endpoint against the four capability properties. Report actual percentages.

open_questions.question: What is the minimal read scope a postcondition probe needs, and can probing be delegated to tool owners rather than held centrally?
open_questions.resolution_method: Design exercise informed by OQ-01 findings.

open_questions.question: Under EVENTUAL consistency with no idempotency key, is natural-key probing acceptable given it can false-positive and suppress a needed retry (a missing side effect rather than a duplicate)?
open_questions.resolution_method: Domain policy decision. Must be configurable per tool with a stated default.

open_questions.question: Idempotency-key stability across replay, once LIVE_REEXECUTION can touch a shared environment.
CAS retention period per sensitivity class. Replay needs payloads; privacy wants them gone. Direct tension.
open_questions.resolution_method: Policy decision with a named owner. Not an engineering choice.

open_questions.question: Multiple-comparison correction across ~30 detectors firing on one incident.
open_questions.resolution_method: Requires Gate 4 firing-rate data before an FDR policy can be chosen.

open_questions.question: Actual current MCP protocol revision and its stability. PROJECT_CONTEXT cites 2026-07-28, unverified. Likewise the exact OpenTelemetry GenAI convention field names and stability level.
open_questions.resolution_method: Read the live specifications. Pin versions. Do not depend on field names until verified.

open_questions.question: How are the ten task classes defined, and how do we avoid a task set that flatters the architecture we already chose?
open_questions.resolution_method: Derive classes from the failure taxonomy rather than from convenience; hold out a set never used during development.

open_questions.question: Is human labelling capacity available for judge calibration, disputed-grade adjudication and held-out review?
open_questions.resolution_method: Ask. If none, remove those controls from the documents rather than describing controls that do not exist.

open_questions.question: Actual tokens-per-call and calls-per-execution for the reference agent.
Does the provider expose token-level rate headers or only request-level? The local bucket must meter tokens.
open_questions.resolution_method: Inspect live response headers at Gate 1.

open_questions.question: Is a LOCAL_MODEL substrate available in the target environment at all?
open_questions.resolution_method: Check the environment. If absent, the 7% local share moves to DETERMINISTIC_STUB and the ladder loses L2.

build_sequence.name: Architecture before implementation
build_sequence.exit: human review + OQ-01, OQ-03, OQ-05 resolved + ADR-0001 accepted

build_sequence.name: Observability substrate
build_sequence.scope: canonical event contract, append-only ledger, CAS with sensitivity classes, reference agent, five synthetic services with declared schemas AND snapshot-restore-by-digest, deterministic stub provider adapter, ground-truth side-effect log unreachable by the agent

build_sequence.name: Runtime assurance
build_sequence.scope: action state machine, capability matrix with contract tests, consistency-model declarations, idempotency keys, postcondition probes with consistency windows, execution-level budgets, three loop detectors, deterministic policy decision table behind an OPA-shaped interface

build_sequence.name: Reliability laboratory
build_sequence.scope: fault injection, per-trial isolation with canaries, paired trial design, McNemar analysis, reliability cell grid with Wilson intervals and printed MDE, substrate split

build_sequence.name: Failure intelligence
build_sequence.scope: deterministic detectors, execution graph with edge budgets, hypothesis candidate generation, ordinal rubric ranking, coverage manifests, evidence label lattice enforcement

build_sequence.name: Replay and counterfactuals
build_sequence.scope: exact and controlled replay, egress guard, divergence detector, counterfactual evidence records with mandatory divergence_rate

build_sequence.name: Context integrity
build_sequence.scope: temporal validity intervals, supersession edges, deterministic staleness check before model call, lexical retrieval baseline with measured miss rate

build_sequence.name: Security and protocol boundary
build_sequence.scope: MCP adapter behind the internal tool protocol, identity binding, untrusted-tool handling, injection containment test suite, canary detection

build_sequence.name: Presentation
build_sequence.scope: read-only rendering of artifacts that already pass headless tests
build_sequence.constraint: NOT a milestone. Every artifact must be produced, tested and exportable headlessly first.

enforced_controls.control: only the gateway imports the transport client or holds a credential
no core analysis module imports a provider, MCP or framework package
metric label sets contain only allow-listed bounded-cardinality keys
EXACT and CONTROLLED replay make zero outbound connections
seeded secrets and synthetic PII never reach the CAS
detector suite passes with the CAS emptied; payload detectors return UNKNOWN
grader isolation; negative-control tasks never pass
no LLM_SYNTHESIS evidence row carries FACT, CORRELATION, OBSERVATION or COUNTERFACTUAL_EVIDENCE
action dispatched without a matching AuthorizationDecision is caught by invariant scan
gateway attempt_no matches the synthetic environment server-side request count
detector crash injection yields an UNKNOWN evidence record, never silence

banned_in_output: a single reliability score without its vector adjacent

permitted_uses: bounded narration over a complete evidence bundle
forbidden_uses: producing any label other than HYPOTHESIS or UNKNOWN
degradation_ladder: L1 fallback with recorded provider_switch and changed deployment_id
L3 template-rendered structured report, zero inference
llm_usage_policy.l3_requirement: structured output must be byte-identical to L0 structured output; only the prose paragraph may differ

next_action: HUMAN_REVIEW. Do not begin Gate 1 implementation. Resolve OQ-01 first: it determines whether the core product thesis survives contact with real tool surfaces.
